steps.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord, validate release/target/destination, and checkpoint INSPECTING. Read-only.
Open the supplied TaskRecord, define parse/build/artifact and any guest requirements, then checkpoint PLANNING with an exact file plan. Do not approve unspecified content.
Open the supplied TaskRecord and prepare one content-bound ChangeSet. Apply only after exact human approval; otherwise stop without writing. Checkpoint the applied diff.

standards.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord and review the exact applied ChangeSet against scarthgap standards. If nothing was approved/applied, report PAUSED.

parse.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord. If a ChangeSet was applied, checkpoint VERIFYING, parse, run iteration-1 target build, inspect artifacts and execute required guest behavior. Otherwise stop without jobs.

reducer.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord. Merge review/verification Evidence, update each requirement, and checkpoint COMPLETED with finalSummary only if all required items passed; otherwise PAUSED/FAILED with resume action.
